title: Detailed gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bagBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5a8a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d81b60'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bagSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b0124b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e0316f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe57f'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f9a825'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M30 38 C30 12, 70 12, 70 38' fill='none' stroke='#f9a825' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 38 C30 14, 70 14, 70 38' fill='none' stroke='#ffe57f' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bag body -->
  <rect x='18' y='36' width='64' height='56' rx='4' fill='url(#bagBody)'/>
  <!-- right side panel shade -->
  <path d='M72 36 L82 36 L82 92 L72 92 Z' fill='url(#bagSide)'/>
  <path d='M18 36 L72 36 L82 36 L72 36 Z' fill='none'/>

  <!-- top fold / rim -->
  <rect x='18' y='36' width='64' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ff8fb3'/>
  <rect x='18' y='36' width='64' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffc1d6'/>

  <!-- diagonal stripes decoration -->
  <g opacity='0.85'>
    <path d='M24 50 L40 50 L24 70 L8 70 Z' fill='#ffd166' transform='translate(10 0)'/>
    <path d='M24 64 L40 64 L24 84 L8 84 Z' fill='#ffd166' transform='translate(10 0)'/>
    <path d='M24 78 L40 78 L24 98 L8 98 Z' fill='#ffd166' transform='translate(10 0)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- highlight sheen -->
  <path d='M26 44 L34 44 L30 88 L22 88 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- bow on front -->
  <g transform='translate(50 66)'>
    <ellipse cx='-9' cy='0' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <ellipse cx='9' cy='0' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <ellipse cx='-9' cy='0' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
    <ellipse cx='9' cy='0' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='5' fill='#f9a825'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2.5' fill='#fff3c4'/>
    <path d='M-3 4 L-7 12 L-2 9 Z' fill='#e8b100'/>
    <path d='M3 4 L7 12 L2 9 Z' fill='#e8b100'/>
  </g>

  <!-- small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='2' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='76' r='2' fill='#fff3c4'/>
</svg>
